data.rationale: Makes local-model output recoverable without trusting the first response or requiring a second full prompt containing the book text.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks generation shall retry exactly once with a compact repair prompt when the initial narrator-and-character source-span response is malformed JSON or semantically invalid, including missing confidence, illegal span IDs, hallucinated halo span IDs, unknown speakers, duplicate spans, out-of-order spans, or incomplete coverage.

data.rationale: Gives LM Studio and other local providers a stricter response envelope than a generic JSON object while keeping the app-owned source-span contract single-versioned.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks generation shall request the narrator-and-character source-span selection contract with an operation-specific structured-output schema hint whenever the selected AI profile supports structured output.

data.rationale: Protects unpublished book text while preserving enough diagnostic detail to tune local-model behavior.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks validation and repair logging shall report compact failure categories, chunk or segment identifiers, and rejected speaker or span identifiers without logging full source chunk or book text through the validation-failure path.

data.rationale: Keeps Speech Blocks review usable after local-model failure and avoids corrupting downstream audio generation with rewritten or reordered text.
data.requirement: When both the initial and repair source-span responses are unusable, Speech Blocks generation shall create deterministic fallback blocks in source order using safe narrator defaults and warning metadata while preserving exact source text reconstruction.
